annotations.title: Read a Google Local Services conversation

description:
[read-only] Messages and call durations for a Google Local Services leadId returned by ads_local_services_leads, through this brand’s selected Google Ads account. Read only; no recording links.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/leads/local-services/{leadId}/conversation.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.
